guides.definition: Creates a Zod object schema and derives its TypeScript type. Requires Zod in the active TypeScript/Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: typeName
parameters.description: Type alias inferred from the schema.

examples.title: Define a user schema
examples.explanation: Inferring the type keeps runtime validation and compile-time shape anchored to one schema definition.

guides.definition: Uses safeParse and branches on the discriminated result. Requires Zod in the active TypeScript/Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

examples.title: Validate request data
examples.explanation: safeParse keeps expected validation failures in normal control flow and narrows result.data to the inferred schema type.

guides.definition: Validates environment strings and coerces a port to a bounded integer. Requires Zod in the active TypeScript/Node.js project; Hypershell does not install it.

parameters.name: nameKey
parameters.description: Environment variable containing a required service name.

parameters.name: portKey
parameters.description: Environment variable containing the TCP port.

examples.title: Parse service settings
examples.explanation: Coercion converts the environment string before numeric constraints run; parse throws at startup when configuration is invalid.
